stories.subject: Gunna / Pop It
stories.headline: GUNNA POP IT
stories.deck: Gunna’s new single “Pop It” is out for New Music Friday, arriving as a standalone Gunna Music release. The drop keeps the Atlanta rapper active in the rollout lane while fans wait for the next full project.
stories.verification: The Music Universe announced Pop It for the Oct. 9 New Music Friday slate, and Apple Music lists the Gunna Music single as released in October 2026.

stories.subject: Ovrkast. / STRIKING / OutKast trademark dispute
stories.headline: OVRKAST. STRIKING NOW
stories.deck: Ovrkast.’s 12-track STRIKING is out today with Joey Bada$$, MAVI, Samara Cyn and Niontay among the guests. The Oakland rapper-producer is releasing it while OutKast’s trademark company sues over his name, turning a new album into a live test of identity and ownership.
stories.verification: HotNewHipHop and Pitchfork confirm the Oct. 9 STRIKING release and guest list; Music Business Worldwide and NME report the separate federal trademark dispute over the Ovrkast. name.

stories.subject: NetEase Cloud Music / gamma. China partnership
stories.headline: GAMMA. GOES EAST
stories.deck: NetEase Cloud Music and gamma. announced a multi-year China partnership for licensed releases from artists including Ye, Mariah Carey, Sexyy Red, Usher and Snoop Dogg. The deal makes NetEase a launch platform for gamma.’s global roster and expands the route between international catalog and Chinese listeners.
stories.verification: PR Newswire APAC carries the partnership announcement and roster details; Rap Industry independently reports the same Oct. 8 music-business development and its China distribution focus.

stories.subject: Tupac Shakur / The Tupac Prison Interview
stories.headline: TUPAC UNCUT
stories.deck: The Tupac Prison Interview premieres Oct. 12 at 9 p.m. ET on YouTube, presenting Patrick Heaphy’s extended 1995 conversation with Shakur inside Clinton Correctional Facility. Original camera and source tapes are also headed to auction, turning a long-hidden conversation into a new archival event.
stories.verification: PR Newswire’s LCM247 release gives the premiere time, interview location, anniversary timing, and auction plan; The Music Universe independently carries the premiere announcement and archival context.

stories.subject: Grand Theft Auto VI Collection / Rockstar Store
stories.headline: GTA VI MERCH GOES LIVE
stories.deck: Rockstar has made the official GTA VI Collection available through the Rockstar Store, with apparel and collectibles inspired by Vice City and Leonida. It is a merchandise drop—not the game itself—and it gives fans a physical pre-launch lane ahead of the Nov. 19 release.
stories.verification: Rockstar’s Newswire lists the GTA VI Collection as available at the Rockstar Store; ComingSoon reports the apparel and collectible contents and the pre-launch context.

source_policy: At least two current reputable sources per story; five distinct stories; no stale or repeated topics from prior batches.
